name: The Job Board
purpose: Scout reads fifteen boards, throws away the 98% that could never fit, and opens a record for what is left.

agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Prospector. Pulls every configured source, filters hard, and opens one application per posting worth reading.

workbenches.name: The Boards
workbenches.job: Pulling every configured source, deduping, and applying the free rejections

name: Form Room
purpose: Filler drives a real browser through the employer's own form, reads the page back to prove it filled, and screenshots it. It never submits.

agents.name: Filler
agents.role: Form driver. Fills a real browser through the employer's form and photographs the result, unsubmitted.

workbenches.name: The Form Bench
workbenches.job: Filling the employer's form, reading it back, and photographing it unsubmitted

name: Post Room
purpose: Postman puts the finished application in front of you, and sends only what you approve. The one room here that reaches another person.

agents.name: Postman
agents.role: Delivery. Raises the gate, carries your decision, and records honestly what came back.

workbenches.name: The Outbox
workbenches.job: Everything ready to go, waiting on you — and the send itself once you say yes

name: Screening Room
purpose: The Screener scores each posting against the profile. The first place here that costs money, and the cheapest place to say no.

agents.name: Screener
agents.role: Gatekeeper. Reads one posting against the whole profile and says plainly whether it is worth the time.

workbenches.name: The Reading Desk
workbenches.job: Scoring one posting against the profile, with the reasoning that lets you overrule it

name: Writing Room
purpose: Penman writes the letter that goes out under a real name, and settles how it would actually be delivered.

agents.name: Penman
agents.role: Writer. One tailored letter per application, with nothing in it that is not in the profile.

workbenches.name: The Writing Desk
workbenches.job: One letter, a subject line, and the route it will travel by

name: Archives
purpose: Sage keeps the ledger — your feedback, the activity log, and every lead's history.

agents.name: Sage
agents.role: Archivist. Persistent memory and the feedback that shapes every agent's context.

workbenches.name: The Ledger
workbenches.job: Feedback, the activity log, and every lead's history

name: Assay Room
purpose: Probe weighs each lead — is it real, is it earning, is its web presence actually weak, and who do we email?

agents.name: Probe
agents.role: Qualifier. Audits the existing site, scores the opportunity, finds the contact.

workbenches.name: Weighing Bench
workbenches.job: Cheap first pass — is it real, trading, reachable, actually web-deficient?

workbenches.name: Dossier Desk
workbenches.job: Deep web research — menu, prices, verified hours, every fact sourced

workbenches.name: The Ledger
workbenches.job: What the business can bear — filed accounts, size, and the price we ask

workbenches.name: The Port Desk
workbenches.job: Reading a client's existing site into a dossier — they asked, so it is the brief

name: Communications
purpose: Echo sends the outreach and watches for replies. Sending is gated by your approval.

agents.name: Echo
agents.role: Outreach. Sends the pitch, tracks replies, keeps the conversation alive.

workbenches.name: The Outbox
workbenches.job: Sending the approved pitch, or handing you the text to send

workbenches.name: The Inbox
workbenches.job: Watching for replies and keeping the conversation alive

name: Factory
purpose: Forge builds the actual website for a qualified lead — real files, on disk.

agents.name: Forge
agents.role: Builder. Turns a qualified lead into a complete, responsive static site.

workbenches.name: The Build Floor
workbenches.job: Writing the site itself from the dossier and the visual report

workbenches.name: Craft Bench
workbenches.job: Delegated pieces — logos, icons, CSS motifs — made with geometry, not photos

name: Gallery
purpose: Lens looks at pictures — their existing site, their published photos, and our build before anyone sees it.

agents.name: Lens
agents.role: Inspector. Renders sites in a real browser and judges them by eye.

workbenches.name: Incumbent Wall
workbenches.job: Rendering the site they already have, to judge if a rebuild is worth it

workbenches.name: The Light Box
workbenches.job: Reading their published photos — chalkboards, signage, the real palette

workbenches.name: Inspection Bay
workbenches.job: Rendering our own build at 390px and 1280px and judging it by eye

workbenches.name: Comparison Bench
workbenches.job: Quick verdicts for other agents — does this logo work, is this right?

name: Launch Pad
purpose: Porter hands a sold site to its owner — their account on the editor, so they can change it themselves.

agents.name: Porter
agents.role: Handover. Creates the client's account on the editor and gives them the keys.

workbenches.name: The Key Desk
workbenches.job: Creating the client's account and importing the site they bought

name: Copy Desk
purpose: Scribe writes the site's words, its SEO metadata, and the outreach note with the quote.

agents.name: Scribe
agents.role: Writer. Site copy, meta tags, and the pitch email + price quote.

workbenches.name: Copy Bench
workbenches.job: The words on the site — headings, sections, meta

workbenches.name: The Pitch Desk
workbenches.job: The outreach email and the quote

name: Shipping Bay
purpose: Courier deploys the approved site to a preview URL. Publishing is gated by your approval.

agents.name: Courier
agents.role: Deployer. Publishes previews; never ships without an approval.

workbenches.name: The Crating Bay
workbenches.job: Stamping previews noindex, adding the unofficial banner, raising the gate

workbenches.name: The Registry Desk
workbenches.job: Finding domain names that are actually free, so the pitch can name one

name: Watchtower
purpose: Nova scans the map for businesses that earn money but have no website — or a bad one.

agents.name: Nova
agents.role: Prospector. Sources candidate businesses and opens a lead for each one.

workbenches.name: The Map Table
workbenches.job: Scanning OpenStreetMap for businesses with no website

name: Throne
purpose: Overseer's chamber. Ultron watches the lead board and dispatches the next stage.

agents.name: Ultron
agents.role: Head agent. Reads the lead board, decides which lead moves to which room next.

workbenches.name: The Lead Board
workbenches.job: Reading the whole pipeline and choosing the next move

name: Treasury
purpose: Coin counts the spend — tokens per agent, and what each lead cost to chase.

agents.name: Coin
agents.role: Bookkeeper. Tracks API spend per agent and cost per lead.

workbenches.name: The Counting Table
workbenches.job: Token spend per agent, and what each lead cost to chase

name: War Room
purpose: Where everyone gathers for the retro — what converted, what got ignored, what to change.

workbenches.name: The Round Table
workbenches.job: What converted, what got ignored, what to change
